**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

§ 28.1 selects New York law and disapplies the CISG; § 28.2 gives the state and federal courts in New York County exclusive jurisdiction with irrevocable submission to personal jurisdiction and a waiver of venue/inconvenient-forum objections. The limited carve-out for temporary injunctive relief in another court is customary interim relief and does not undermine the exclusive merits forum. No arbitration provision exists anywhere in the Agreement — § 28.3 is only a pre-filing executive escalation that expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-preserving filings — and § 30 contains no competing forum. No redline proposed.
